# Request contract

What the backend accepts, as enforced by `mace-api/contract.py` (contract v1, app v2.2.0).
The UI and the Next.js routes read the same file, so this page, the code and the
interface cannot disagree. Decisions: [ADR-0021](../adr/0021-model-registry-mpa0-default.md),
[ADR-0022](../adr/0022-shared-request-contract.md).

## Calculation types

Supported: `single-point`, `geometry-opt`, `molecular-dynamics`. Refused with an explanation: `phonon`.
MD ensembles: NVT, NPT, NVE (NPT requires a fully periodic cell). Precisions: float32, float64. Devices: cpu, cuda.
Structure files: `.xyz`, `.extxyz`, `.cif`, `.poscar`, `.vasp`, `.contcar`, `.pdb`, or a bare `POSCAR`/`CONTCAR`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forceThreshold` | number | 0.05 | 0.001 – 1 | eV/Å |
| `maxOptSteps` | integer | 500 | 1 – 5000 | steps |
| `temperature` | number | 300 | 0 – 5000 | K |
| `pressure` | number | 0 | 0 – 1000 | GPa |
| `timeStep` | number | 1 | 0.1 – 4 | fs |
| `friction` | number | 0.005 | 0.0001 – 0.1 | 1/fs |
| `mdSteps` | integer | 100 | 1 – 100000 | steps |
| `seed` | integer | 42 | 0 – 4294967295 | — |

Every number must be finite; booleans are not numbers; step counts must be whole.

## Models

Default when `modelType` is omitted: **MACE-MPA-0**.

| Model | Domain | Sizes | Level of theory | Licence | Hosted |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MACE-MPA-0` | materials | medium | PBE/PBE+U (MPtrj + sAlex) | MIT | yes |
| `MACE-MP-0` | materials | small, medium, large | PBE/PBE+U (MPtrj) | MIT | yes |
| `MACE-OFF` (alias `MACE-OFF23`) | organic | small, medium, large | ωB97M-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVPPD DFT (SPICE) | ASL | yes |
| `custom` | custom | — | — | your own | no |

Every foundation checkpoint is pinned by SHA-256; a file that does not match its pin is refused
before it is unpickled ([ADR-0020](../adr/0020-trusted-checkpoint-loading.md)).

## Energy conventions

| Convention | Description | Enforced by the validator (eV/atom) | Typical (eV/atom) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mp` | PBE/PBE+U DFT reference energies (Materials Project convention) | -20 to 100 | -15 to -1 |
| `off` | ωB97M-D3(BJ) total energies including core electrons — large and negative, and much larger for Br and I | -800 to 100 | -600 to -100 |
| `unknown` | No convention known (custom checkpoint); the energy range check is skipped | skipped | — |

The enforced band is what the advisory validator checks: below the minimum is a warning,
above the maximum an issue. The typical band is for orientation only.
